title: Distribute multi-line flexible items to the top and bottom of the container
goal: Use align-content to lay out multi-line Flex tracks.
summary: spare parts cabinet picture shows two boxes in each row, two rows in total. The first row is attached to the top and the second row is attached to the bottom.
tasks: sets space-between for the entire set of rows in .cabinet so that multiple rows are distributed at the top and bottom.
retains line breaks and box size.

example.code: .shelf { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-content: space-between; }
example.note: align-content allocates extra space between multiple lines. align-items aligns each item in a row.

hint: This is the row distribution attribute of the container and is not written on individual boxes.
